# Apex Digital Forge

> Apex Digital Forge is a white-label SEO and link-building agency based in Jaipur, India, serving both end businesses and digital marketing agencies worldwide. Services include on-page SEO, technical SEO, off-page link building, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI search visibility. For agencies, Apex Digital Forge fulfills white-label backlink campaigns (DA 50–90 verified links) and SEO deliverables so partner agencies can scale client work without expanding in-house teams.

## Company

- Founder: Ravi Bairwa
- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India
- Contact: apexdigitalforge@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.apexdigitalforge.in

## What Apex Digital Forge Does

- White-label link building for SEO agencies (DA 50–90 verified backlinks, live reporting, 7–10 day delivery)
- On-page and technical SEO for end businesses across industries (local services, healthcare, SaaS, ecommerce, real estate, and more)
- Local SEO for businesses across India and internationally
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — helping brands appear in AI-powered search and answer engines
